Ayodhya Ram Temple Trust Leaders Resign Amid Donation Probe

Leaders of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust, including General Secretary Champat Rai and member Anil Mishra, have resigned amid an investigation into alleged donation irregularities. The Trust has advanced an emergency meeting to finalize these resignations and discuss operational restructuring for transparency. The State Bank of India had reportedly recommended replacing cash-counting staff months prior to the surfacing of the controversy.
